name: Default Download Strategy
description: Base strategy inherited by all conferences unless overridden. Covers standard paper fetch, DOI resolution, and citation lookup via the searcher API.

steps.name: Fetch Papers
steps.description: Call the searcher API to retrieve paper metadata for the conference year.

config.notes: POST body includes conference slug, year, and download_sources. Response is a list of paper objects.

steps.name: Resolve DOIs
steps.description: For each paper returned, verify and normalise the DOI using the CrossRef API.

config.notes: Skip papers that already have a validated DOI in the database.

steps.name: Fetch Citation Count
steps.description: Retrieve citation counts for each paper from the searcher citation endpoint.

config.notes: Requires a valid DOI. Results are stored in paper metadata.

steps.name: Upsert to Library
steps.description: Bulk-upsert all processed papers into the paper library database.

config.notes: Existing records are updated only for fields returned by the searcher; existing fields not in the response are preserved.
